description:
Offline Catholic daily readings and liturgical calendar, Ordinary and 1962
dlectio shows the day's Mass readings of the Roman Rite, entirely on your device and with no internet.

No servers, no accounts, no ads, no tracking. The app declares no permissions at all — not even INTERNET — because it never needs one. The liturgical calendar and the readings are computed on your device and the scripture text is bundled in the app, so nothing is ever sent anywhere.

Both forms are included: the Ordinary Form and the 1962 form. Pick the one you follow in Settings, along with the translation, the interface language, the theme, and which parts of the readings to show.

The calendar is computed rather than looked up in a table, so every date from 1583 to 2200 is reachable — not just the years someone remembered to tabulate. The computation is checked day by day against independent references.

Bundled scripture texts:

* Latin Vulgate (Clementine) — public domain
* Biblia Jakuba Wujka (Polish) — public domain
* Douay-Rheims (Challoner, English) — public domain
* Greek New Testament — SBLGNT, © 2010 Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software, CC BY 4.0, modified for this app (critical-apparatus sigla stripped, books outside the Vulgate canon omitted)

The name is a play on words: d for daily plus lectio, and together dilectio — the love of reading God's word.

The liturgical engine is lectio, a separate program licensed under the AGPL v3. dlectio itself is GPL v3. Both are free software, and the source of each is published.
